# Analysis

Only the initial data preparation and squared deviations are reused.

```{r}
values <- c(12, 15, 18, 20, 21, 23, 25, 26)
size <- length(values)
center <- mean(values)
deviations <- values - center
squares <- deviations ^ 2
sum_squares <- sum(squares)
```

The variance estimate and uncertainty calculation are not included in this excerpt.
